metadata.description: OMEGA-ENGINEERING X10: ten engineering skill sources integrated as separately installable plugins with one master router (omega-core).

plugins.name: omega-core
plugins.description: OMEGA-ENGINEERING X10 master router: maps any engineering task to the right specialist skill across all ten integrated sources, with a searchable registry and doctor checks.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Vercel agent-browser: browser automation CLI skill (navigate, snapshot, click, fill, screenshot, sessions, Electron, Slack, dogfood QA). Requires the agent-browser CLI.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering: grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more. Plug-and-play, not vibe coding.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills-extras
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's non-promoted skills: misc/ (rarely used) and in-progress/ (beta, feedback wanted). Upstream ships these outside its plugin.

plugins.name: replica-skill
plugins.description: Eleven free Claude skills that clone any app: reverse-engineer it, rebuild it, test it for bugs, then fix what its users hate. Free, MIT.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: Harness-native ECC plugin for engineering teams - 71 agents, 311 skills, 97 legacy command shims, reusable hooks, rules, MCP conventions, and operator workflows for Claude Code plus adjacent agent harnesses

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Vercel find-skills: discover and install skills from the open agent skills ecosystem via the `npx skills` CLI.

plugins.name: anti-pattern-czar
plugins.description: Anti-Pattern Czar (from claude-mem's own dev tooling): /anti-pattern-czar runs a TypeScript error-handling anti-pattern detector over ./src and walks you through fixing each finding. Needs Bun.

plugins.name: vibesec
plugins.description: VibeSec: secure coding guide for web applications from a bug hunter's perspective (access control, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, uploads, SQLi, XXE, path traversal, JWT, API, headers).

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence. Searchable local database with 79 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, 25 charts, and 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt.js, Nuxt UI, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max-design-stack
plugins.description: UI UX Pro Max 'Claude Website Design Stack': design-review subagent plus /design-plan and /design-review commands. Optional MCP servers in optional/mcp.json.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Graphify: turn code, docs, papers, images or video into a queryable knowledge graph (/graphify, query, path, explain, MCP, exports). Requires `uv tool install graphifyy`.
